name: Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (via National Scholarship Portal)
benefit: Tuition and maintenance support for post-matric students
verification_note: Seed data written from public knowledge; confirm rules, amounts and URLs on the official source before relying on them.
deadline_note: Application window opens each academic year; check the portal notice
notes: The family income limit is revised from time to time — check the notice.

rules.text: Belongs to the Scheduled Caste category
Annual family income is at or below Rs 2.5 lakh (the limit is revised from time to time — check the notice)

documents.name: Aadhaar (identity only — do not enter the number in this app)

steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Fill the application with your institution details
Upload the caste and income certificates
Get the application verified by your college, then note the application number and track it on the portal
